name: InterCAX Syndeia
description: An API-first digital-thread platform for connecting, querying, visualizing, and automating model and engineering data across SysML tools, PLM, ALM, CAD, simulation, and repositories.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. Syndeia is classified as an integration platform, not a SysML model editor.
classificationNotes: The SysML v2 standard tag denotes an integration target; Syndeia is not represented as implementing the modeling language itself.
A product-specific REST API does not by itself establish support for the OMG Systems Modeling API and Services specification.
